When Kid Danger and Captain Man battle the Time Jerker, Kid Danger accidentally falls into the Time Jerker's time machine and relives the same day over again.
Henry's life as Kid Danger is threatened when Charlotte grows suspicious about the secrets he has been keeping.

The sisters think Lincoln is bad luck so they ban him from attending their activities; when Lincoln finds out his class is dissecting frogs, he and Lana embark on a mission to rescue them.

Lincoln worries that he has lost his manliness from growing up with sisters, so he and Clyde decide to go camping; Lincoln gets Lori a job at a pizza arcade, but Lori gets in trouble when he starts to ask for favors.

Lori and Lincoln visit the city, where Lori struggles to be a city girl; Lincoln finds that Ronnie Anne has changed; the family uses stunt doubles in its plan to avoid Luan's April Fool's Day pranking.

60fb01a24795a6000762fe83: The Wolves have become strong because of the stolen Chi. And now they are stealing even more. Soon all the other tribes of Chima have none. Laval and Eris must find a new, clever and “Wolf proof” way to get Chi to the tribes.
Jay is trapped on Nadakhan’s ship, as Nadakhan tries to force him to make his third wish. Lloyd, Cole, and Nya are marooned on Tiger Widow Island.
The ninja are trying to figure out a way to save Jay from Nadakhan’s ship. Two screenwriters, Kevin and Dan, suggest that they build a fake raid zeppelin and disguise themselves as Sky Pirates.

Jay and Nya have been holed up at the police precinct, but the Sky Pirates track him down. They flee by boat to the lighthouse where Zane’s father was once held captive. Nadakhan learns that the ninja still have the Tiger Widow venom.
LEGO Ninjago: Day of the Departed

Cole returns to Yang’s haunted temple to seek revenge on the former Airjitzu Master who turned him into a ghost, he accidentally uses a Dark Magic blade that unleashes the spectral forms of Ninjago’s greatest villains and traps himself in the temple!
Master Wu mistakenly tries to single-handedly complete a battle he began decades ago against Acronix, one of the twin Hands of Time.
The Ninja learn more about the Krux and Acronix – the two fallen Elemental Masters known as the Hands of Time – and are sure that this threat has finally been eliminated.
Kai's investigation of a Vermillion Warrior Helmet leads him to discover that Krux is alive and well in Ninjago, living under an assumed identity.
In the midst of an epidemic of mysterious metal thefts by the Vermillion Warriors, Lloyd realizes that stepping up and taking over for the ailing Master Wu is not an easy task.
While the Ninja fight to save MegaMonster Amusement Park, Jay struggles to defend his family's home from the Vermillion Warriors.

The Ninja celebrate their escape from the Vermillion Army and their retrieval of the Emerald Time Blade, but with Acronix and Krux determined to get their Blade back, the Airjitzu Temple becomes a battleground.

Secrets are revealed as Nya confronts the Samurai X imposter, Kai pursues the truth about his parents and the other Ninja desperately seek to locate and rescue Master Wu. But as usual, some answers only lead to more questions.
Kai confronts his dad for aiding the Hands of Time, only to discover that his parents are actually Acronix and Krux's captives.

The Hands of Time blackmail Kai and Nya into using their combined Elemental powers to retrieve the fourth and final Time Blade from the Boiling Sea with the promise that the siblings can use its reversal power to save the quickly-fading Master Wu.

Kai and Nya stow away aboard Krux and Acronix’s time-traveling snake mech in a desperate attempt to save Master Wu. But when they arrive in the past, they must help the Elemental Masters prevent the Hands of Time from re-writing Ninjago history.
When an unknown criminal syndicate threatens the Royal Family, the Ninja are called back into action and must protect the royal princess and a fabled artifact that may hold supernatural powers.
In the wake of a vicious attack upon the palace, the Sons of Garmadon steal the second Oni Mask, and the ninja invite the royal princess, Harumi, into their makeshift family.
While Princess Harumi adjusts to life with the ninja, Lloyd and Jay search for answers about the Oni Masks, while Cole and Zane attempt to infiltrate the Sons of Garmadon.
In order to join the Sons of Garmadon, Zane (aka Snake Jaguar) participates in a deadly motorcycle initiation race.
Zane’s near demise at the hands of Mr. E forces the ninja to flee aboard the Bounty, where they discover that a transmission Zane intercepted may reveal the hidden location of the Quiet One.
As Lloyd and Harumi venture deep into Primeval’s Eye in search of the third Oni Mask, the ninja attempt to fix the Bounty and make a startling discovery.
As Lloyd and Harumi search the Oni Temple for the last mask, the ninja are taken hostage and discover Princess Harumi’s true intentions.
The ninja appeal to the police commissioner of Ninjago in an effort to help save Lloyd and thwart Harumi’s efforts to resurrect the evil Lord Garmadon.

Just when the Ninja think they have saved the day, Lord Garmadon returns to NINJAGO, and frees Harumi, who encourages him to “achieve his true potential” by conquering the one thing that has always stood in his way… his son, Lloyd.
The ninja race to save Lloyd, as a more powerful-than-ever Lord Garmadon creates an enormous Colossi to help him rule NINJAGO and defeat the ninja.
Ninjago has become a bleak, enemy-occupied city ruled by Emperor Garmadon and his Sons of Garmadon biker gang.
Jay, Kai and Zane are interrogated by Iron Baron, the ruthless warlord to the Dragon Hunters. Feeling threatened, the Ninja choose to keep their identities secret.

As the Ninja are put into a cage aboard a hunting party, they learn that their elemental powers will be used to help lure a dragon. Undercover, Cole learns Iron Baron is in search for Firstbourne’s nest – the Mother of All Dragons.

After a flashback of when Jay first meets Master Wu, Jay awakens to find he’s still with his caged friends returning from their hunting party. Forced into slave labor, Jay’s inspired by his dream of his master when Wu told him to ‘build the impossible’.

Dareth warns his friends just as the Sons of Garmadon ambush their secret headquarters. The Elemental Masters are each captured, except for Lloyd, Nya, Dareth and Skylor, who escape within Nya’s escape vehicle.
As Lloyd and his friends lick their wounds, Mystake shares how she managed to escape the Sons of Garmadon earlier -- she’s a shape-shifting Oni.
In the wastelands, Faith teaches the Ninja how to master their chain rifles and they hunt a dragon. As teen Wu struggles, Kai encourages him to not give up in a lesson of confidence.

Harumi has outed Mystake as the ‘Fake Harumi’. Mystake reveals her true Oni form and battles Garmadon, allowing Skylor to absorb some of his power and escape. In the Realm of Oni and Dragon, the Ninja return to rescue Faith, only to discover it’s a trap.
Garmadon is enraged by the loss of Harumi and releases his wrath by ordering the Oni Titan to turn Ninjago City to ash. Lloyd fears they won’t be able to endure much longer – where are his friends?
Atop their dragons, the Ninja return to Ninjago City amidst Garmadon’s vicious attack. Master Wu and the Ninja join up with Lloyd, Nya, and Dareth and they celebrate their reunion.
Nya helps Zane backup memories of their adventures to the Samurai X Cave computer, but Zane encounters a mysterious puzzle buried deep within his code.

The officers of 15 Division are still reeling in the aftermath of the unexpected death of one of their colleagues. When they discover that a laptop has been stolen containing sensitive information, they set out to tie up several of open cases

When a violent child abductor escapes from an emergency hospital visit, 15 Division goes on the hunt for the criminal -- only to discover that heʼs taken another young victim

After six months working undercover, Andy and Nick’s operation goes sideways when Nick, then Andy go missing. Meanwhile, a random arrest at 15 Division puts Sam Swarek and the other officers in the middle of the investigation-turned-rescue-mission

On her first day back at 15 Division, Andy must work with Swarek to track down an ex convict determined to get his old life back at any cost. Andy realizes just how much has changed since she walked away from her old life six months ago

Andy is partnered with Swarek’s new girlfriend, Officer Marlo Cruz. When they come face-to-face with an out of control EDP [Emotionally Disturbed Person], their differences are put to the test and one of them has to pull the trigger.
65ddec1ef7f0af0008be4b65: Abby y Laura descubren la verdadera razón de su conexión. Sam, el chico volador del futuro salva a Dark Rudy de un atracador. Mientras, animando los avances de Greg, Finn cree que accidentalmente mató a su trabajador de la condicional.
Desde que atiende el grupo de apoyo. El alter ego de Rudy, Rudy 2,  se ha convertido en su propia persona.
El equipo ayuda a la tripulación de una estación de investigación oceánica amenazada por una criatura prehistórica que antes se creía extinta.
Shalimar accede a regañadientes a ponerse en contacto con su padre cuando el equipo se entera de que su empresa está involucrada en pruebas y manipulación genética.

En la emocionante apertura de la temporada, los miembros supervivientes de Mutante X emergen de una explosión mortal para encontrarse con Lexa, quien les hace comenzar a cuestionar las suposiciones fundamentales sobre su mundo.
El equipo de Mutante X debe detener la subasta de una sustancia altamente letal que una serie de notorios terroristas internacionales están compitiendo por adquirir.
El equipo de Mutante X llega para ayudar a una base militar que se ha infectado con una enfermedad mortal.
El equipo de Mutante X debe detener a un asesino en serie que deja pistas a sus próximas víctimas en forma de rompecabezas.
Cuando Lexa es drogada sin saberlo con una sustancia letal, el equipo debe correr para encontrar el antídoto antes de que sea demasiado tarde.
Se llama al equipo de Mutante X para investigar actividades extrañas que ocurren en un hospital local.
El equipo de Mutante X se embarca en una misión para localizar y capturar a un poderoso super-mutante que posee poderes divinos.
Jesse se ve obligado a volver a conectarse con su ex prometida cuando el equipo de Mutante X se entera de que su empresa está involucrada en la manipulación genética de cultivos.
Dylan y Rommie deben rescatar a Tyr, Harper y Rev de un Magog Worldship.
Dylan, Beka, Rev y Tyr se estrellan después de escapar de una banda de Nietzscheans, pero pronto se enfrentan a una nueva amenaza: la necesidad de Rev de alimentarse.
La tripulación debe robar una joya que está en el centro de una disputa entre un dueño de Drift y el Than. Beka se enamora de un jefe de seguridad que antes era un ladrón.
Andrómeda responde a una llamada de socorro cuando un barco de carga es atacado.
Dylan, Beka y Trance van con Rommie para averiguar cómo se está desarrollando un arma en un planeta que desconfía de la IA.

Un planeta de sobrevivientes de la Mancomunidad liderados por la ex prometida de Dylan es invitado a unirse a la nueva Mancomunidad, pero cuando votan para no unirse, los Magog son sospechosos de jugar sucio.
Un agente del Abismo intenta atraer a Harper para que se una al Magog.
Cuando rescatan a un joven príncipe de un levantamiento que mata al resto de su familia, se les pide a Dylan y Tyr que sean sus asesores.
Dylan y su nueva flota de la Mancomunidad se amen a la flota Drago-Kazov, pero la encuentran mucho más grande de lo esperado.
642d4493aa2d690008f0a03f: Yugi und seine Freunde erfahren alle Geheimnisse rund um die sagenumwobenen Millenniumsgegenstände. Der verwundete Priester Akunadin besinnt sich auf die längst vergangenen Tage zurück, in welchen die Millenniumsgegenstände zum Leben erwacht wurden.

Im Duell gegen Bakuras Diabound,  möchte der Pharao die ägyptische Götterkarte Slifer spielen. Doch erst muss der Pharao die Bewohner eines Dorfes vor Bakura retten. Allerdings besitzt Bakuras Diabound die Fähigkeit sich unsichtbar zu machen.

Die sieben Teile des Millenniumspuzzles wurden von Bakura gestohlen. Dadurch ist es ihm möglich, den fürchterlichen  Zorc auferstehen zu lassen. In der Zwischenzeit versucht der Priester Akunadin Kaiba zum neuen Pharao zu machen.

Aufgrund des Verlustes des Millenniumspuzzles, besitzt der Pharao keine Macht mehr. Trotzdem will er in einer letzten Schlacht Bakura besiegen. Währenddessen schmieden Yugi und seine Freunde eigene Pläne, um die Welt zu retten.
Der Pharao stellt sich in der Wüste einem finalen Duell gegen Bakura. Dabei wird Bakuras Diabound immer stärker. Es scheint, als müsse der Pharao als Verlierer das Duell verlassen.

Obwohl der Pharao als Sieger im Duell gegen Bakura hervor geht, kann er den Geist von Bakura immer noch wahrnehmen. Akunadin tritt in Erscheinung und in seinem Besitz sind alle sieben Millenniumsgegenstände.
Akunadin setzt die erbeuteten sieben Millenniumsgegenstände in den geheiligten Stein ein. Infolgedessen ist die Wiederauferstehung von Zorc nicht mehr aufzuhalten.

Akunadin schafft es mithilfe der sieben Millenniumsgegenstände, Zorc wieder auferstehen zu lassen. Auch Bakura kann aufgrund der Energien von Zorc, ins Leben zurück gerufen werden. Er nützt diese zweite Chance, um die Truppen des Pharaos zu splitten.

Yugi gelangt in die letzte Tempelkammer, in welcher der Name des Pharao verborgen ist. In dieser Kammer wartet eine lebensbedrohliche Überraschung auf Yugi. Währenddessen ist das Schicksal von Seto ungewiss.

Das Ziel des mächtigen Zorc ist es, die Welt zu zerstören. Gelingt es Zorc im Spiel der Schatten die Vergangenheit auszulöschen, existiert auch keine Gegenwart mehr. Nur Yugi und seine Freunde sind im Stande, das mächtige Monster zu besiegen.
Der Pharao und seine Wächter versuchen verzweifelt ihre Verteidigungsstellung zu halten. Hierfür versucht der Pharao seine ägyptischen Götterkarten, auch ohne das Millenniumspuzzle zu aktivieren.
Mit der Unterstützung von Exodia, gelingt es dem Pharao sein Millenniumspuzzle zurückzuerobern. Der Pharao ist somit endlich in der Lage seine ägyptischen Götterkarten zu rufen.
Yu-Gi-Oh!: Das Geheimnis der Millenniumsgegenstände  - Teil 1
Obwohl der Pharao seine ägyptischen Götterkarten einsetzt, gelingt es ihm nicht, Zorc zu besiegen. Daraufhin stellen sich Seto und Kaiba einem Duell gegen Zorc.
Yu-Gi-Oh!: Das Geheimnis der Millenniumsgegenstände  - Teil 2
Auch mit der Unterstützung des Pharao, sind Seto und Kaiba nicht in der Lage Zorc zu besiegen. Lediglich Yugi hat als einziger noch die Möglichkeit, dem Pharao zur Hilfe zu kommen.
Gemeinsam konnten die Freunde Bakura sowie Zorc besiegen. Es ist die Zeit gekommen für einen letzten großen Kampf zwischen Yugi und Pharao Atem.
Yu-Gi-Oh!: Showdown in der Wüste  - Teil 1

Das letzte finale Duell zwischen den Kontrahenten Yugi und Atem hat begonnen. Falls Yugi gewinnt, kann er einerseits beweisen, dass er ein starker Kämpfer ist. Andererseits wechselt Atem in das Jenseits und Yugi wird seinen Freund nie wieder sehen.
Yu-Gi-Oh!: Showdown in der Wüste  - Teil 2
Das Duell zwischen den Freunden Yugi und Pharao Atem geht weiter. Dabei setzt der Pharao seine drei ägyptischen Götterkarten ein. Mit welcher Strategie kann Yugi die mächtigen Kreaturen besiegen?
Noch immer behält der Pharao im Duell gegen seinen Freunde Yugi die Oberhand. Yugi versucht mit einer neuen Strategie den Pharao zu besiegen.
Das finale Duell zwischen Yugi und dem Pharao spitzt sich immer mehr zu. Obwohl sie sich näher standen als zwei Brüder, ist die Zeit gekommen, um voneinander Abschied zu nehmen.
When the #1 ranked duelist and ruthless tycoon, Seto Kaiba, kidnaps Yugi's Grandpa to get the rare Blue-Eyes White Dragon card, Yugi must face Kaiba in the ultimate Duel Monsters showdown!
Yu-Gi-Oh!: Der erste Kampf mit Pegasus
Yugi is forced to face Duel Monsters creator, Maximillion Pegasus, in the mysterious Shadow Realm where all the monsters and magic are real. If Yugi loses, Pegasus claims Grandpa's soul as his prize!

Yugi gives up one of his own Star Chips so Joey can board the boat bound for Duelist Kingdom and duel to save his sister's eyesight. Meanwhile, the cheat Weevil tries to cripple Yugi's deck by tossing his best cards overboard!
Pegasus announces that there are many strange secrets that will make his ultimate tournament unlike any they've ever had. Yugi must not only figure the rules out, but master them if he's to survive!
After Yugi defeats Weevil's first wave of Duel Monsters, he's shocked to discover that Weevil has one last trick up his sleeve: a ravenous Great Moth that grows in power with every turn!

Joey finds himself courageously accepting a challenge from veteran duelist, Mai. But when Mai begins to demonstrate an unnerving psychic ability, Joey has to figure out Mai's secret strategy before falling victim to it!
The fisherman duelist baits Yugi into a duel on his own sea playing field for a home-field advantage. Can Yugi adapt to these new settings to turn the tide of battle?

If Yugi is eliminated from the tournament, KaibaCorp's crooked Board of Directors will transfer control of the company from Kaiba to Pegasus! Kaiba's brother Mokuba challenges Yugi to a duel to protect his brother's company!
Yugi must duel a magical doppelganger of Kaiba, created from the greed and power lust Yugi wiped from Kaiba's soul.
Yugi defeats the Blue Eyes White Dragon, but there are two more waiting in the wings! Will the real Kaiba reach Yugi in time to help beat this impersonator?
Joey decides to battle Rex Raptor without his friends' help to prove that he is man enough to take care of Serenity on his own.
Joey duels valiantly, but Rex Raptor has unleashed his secret weapon: the Red Eyes Black Dragon!
Yugi's classmate Bakura, possessed by his Millennium Ring's dark powers, traps Yugi and friends in a Shadow Game where they become the cards themselves!
Yu-Gi-Oh!: Ein Licht am Ende des Tunnels

Pegasus's hired duelist Panik cheats Mai of all her star chips, and Yugi vows to defeat him and win them back. But when Panik's Castle of Dark Illusions enshrouds his monsters in a black mist, how can Yugi defeat an enemy he cannot see?
Despite his astonishing disadvantage, Yugi boldly provokes Panik - "I'll finish you in three turns." Is Yugi bluffing, or does he have the advantage in this battle of wits?

Kaiba descends to the kingdom to face Pegasus. Has Kaiba changed since his battle with Yugi, or is he still the same merciless duelist? A battle between Kaiba's Blue Eyes White Dragon and Joey's Red Eyes Black Dragon holds the answers!
Yu-Gi-Oh!: Die Arena der verlorenen Seelen, Teil 1

Bandit Keith's gang kidnaps Joey to a secret cave with a graveyard playing field. As Yugi and friends search for him, Joey faces Bandit Keith's zombie monsters which become stronger as they return from the grave!
Yu-Gi-Oh!: Die Arena der verlorenen Seelen, Teil 2

Joey's last ditch effort, his lucky Time Wizrad card, fails against Bandit Keith's zombie monsters. But as his lucky streak comes to an end, will his improving skills as a duelist and his love for his sister inspire him to victory?
Yugi and Joey band together in a team battle against the Paradox Brothers with all the Star Chips and entrance to Pegasus's castle on the line!
